bug_semantics: AccessTokenAuthenticator::unserialize() restored cached/stored OAuth authenticator state with PHP unserialize($string, ['allowed_classes' => true]). An attacker who can supply the serialized blob (cache/file overwrite or other injection) can instantiate arbitrary gadget objects; PHP then runs magic methods (__wakeup/__destruct/etc.), yielding object injection and, with common gadgets such as Monolog, RCE (CWE-502). serialize() on the same class produced the matching unsafe rest format.
flaw_origin: On 2022-06-09 Sammyjo20 added serialize/unserialize helpers to AccessTokenAuthenticator as a convenience for persisting OAuth tokens, hard-coding allowed_classes => true. That first-write created the unsafe deserializer; later v2/v3 work only moved or restyled the same call. The methods shipped from v1.3.0 through v3.15.0 and were deleted in the v4 squash that became 4.0.0.

reasoning: CVE-2026-33942 / GHSA-rf88-776r-rcq9 is a published CWE-502 in Saloon's OAuth AccessTokenAuthenticator::unserialize(). The sink is PHP unserialize with allowed_classes enabled, so attacker-controlled stored token blobs can instantiate gadgets. The smallest public first-write of those lines is 85c55f967babe52a690b1d312c1adeaad256579b ('Serialzing helpers'), a regular single-parent commit on the OAuth2 boilerplate branch later merge-committed as PR #62 into v1.3.0. Immediate parent a3261dcc lacks unserialize/allowed_classes anywhere in the tree, so this is not a move, revert, or squash aggregate. Subsequent history (namespace drop, 94208c72 method reorder) preserved the same call. The methods remain on every v1.3+ / v2 / v3 tag through v3.15.0 and are absent from v4.0.0 after d418356b6257a847f92a0bfa0c2d48bb379c731d, matching the advisory range < 4.0.0 patched at 4.0.0. AI attribution is taken only from that BIC commit object: human maintainer Sammyjo20 as author and committer, empty of AI/co-author/bot trailers. A later Cursor marker on the v4 base-URL-override release commit does not reattribute the 2022 introducer. Verdict is therefore NOT_AI.
